# pixelfx (vendored)

A copy of the parts of [pixelfx](https://github.com/patch-gg/pixelfx) this game uses: `core/` and a few effects in `fx/`.
Taken from commit 044e12a (MIT License, see LICENSE and NOTICE.md). Changes, each marked
"Pixel Cat:" in the code: the weather effects take `veil: false` (no haze or ground, to sit over the garden),
and the butterfly takes `wander: false` (holds still; the game moves it). To update, copy the files again from the
repository and redo these changes.
